name: Retro Rugby
detailed_description:
Step onto the pixelated pitch in Retro Rugby, a fast-paced, action-packed 2D rugby experience with a modern twist! Featuring smart AI, physics-based collisions, and smooth controller support, this game delivers an authentic yet accessible rugby experience in a nostalgic top-down isometric style.

Build your dream team in Full Career Mode—buy and sell players, upgrade your scouting level to discover hidden gems, and dominate the world of rugby. Take on international challenges in the World Challenge Series and battle for glory in the 6 Country Clash Tournament.

With smart off-the-ball running, your teammates anticipate plays, making every match feel dynamic and strategic. Whether you're pulling off precise passes, crunching into tackles, or making game-winning tries, every moment is driven by fluid physics and deep tactical gameplay.

Build your dream team in Full Career Mode—buy and sell players, upgrade your scouting level to discover hidden gems, and dominate the world of rugby. Take on international challenges in the World Challenge Series and battle for glory in the 6 Country Clash Tournament.

With smart off-the-ball running, your teammates anticipate plays, making every match feel dynamic and strategic. Whether you're pulling off precise passes, crunching into tackles, or making game-winning tries, every moment is driven by fluid physics and deep tactical gameplay.

Are you ready to lead your team to championship glory? Lace up your boots and get in the game!

Features:
🏉 Classic 2D action with a top-down isometric view
🎮 Full controller support for smooth gameplay
🤖 Smart AI that reacts dynamically on offense and defense
📈 Career Mode – buy & sell players, upgrade scouting, and build a dynasty
🌍 World Challenge Series & 6 Country Clash Tournament
💥 Physics-based collisions for realistic tackles and gameplay flow
⚡ Intelligent off-the-ball movement – your team works with you

It’s time to relive rugby’s golden era—Retro Rugby is calling!
